items.title: Define versioned prompt contract schemas and deterministic digest algorithms
items.context: Add RuntimeContract, RoleContract, PromptEnvelope, PromptMeasurementRecord, and usage observation structures with pinned canonical serialization, line, byte, token-estimator, and repetition algorithms. Story 1 defines PromptEnvelope but must never instantiate a Story-bound envelope.
items.userSees: The CLI can report the exact contract and measurement algorithm versions used for the baseline.
excludes: full or incremental Task Context assembly

items.title: Freeze the canonical lifecycle registry for all 16 prompt roles
items.context: Use the current package prompt registry as the exact role set. Record active, compatibility, and retired states plus replacements/defaultDispatch without changing current legal dispatch behavior; channel is retired, product-reviewer remains active INIT authority, implementation-reviewer is compatibility, and legacy verification names point to verification-intent.
items.userSees: The role report lists exactly 16 roles and clearly separates active, compatibility, and retired roles.

items.title: Expose a reproducible three-layer prompt measurement report and sidecar baseline
items.context: Add a read-only report for bytes, lines, estimated tokens, repetition, assembledPromptTokens, knownDispatchInputTokens availability, and providerProcessedInputTokens availability. The no-Story baseline must use PromptMeasurementRecord and honestly mark unobserved provider input unavailable.
items.userSees: Running the measurement command prints per-role and aggregate costs with unavailable fields shown explicitly instead of zero.

items.title: Prove all existing prompt outputs remain byte-identical and new registries fail closed
items.context: Extend focused smokes/verifiers so all 16 agent_prompt hashes and bytes remain unchanged, role membership/status/replacements are exact, canonical digest changes are detected, missing contract fields fail, and measurement output is deterministic.
items.userSees: Focused verification reports all 16 existing Prompt outputs unchanged while contract and measurement mutation probes fail closed.
excludes: rewriting Prompt bodies to satisfy budgets

happy.desc: Run the existing Proof-or-Stop baseline verifier in read-only mode and prove the canonical registry still contains exactly the same 16 roles, with every generated agent_prompt byte count and whole-output SHA-256 equal to the pre-Story baseline; the verifier must offer no hash-refresh path and docs/requirements/baselines/proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.json must remain byte-identical.

Build packages/main, run the focused prompt-contract/measurement smoke, and run scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs successfully; two measurements of the same pinned inputs must serialize to byte-identical output with identical aggregate and per-role values.

edge.desc: Assert the role registry has exactly 16 unique canonical role IDs and exact lifecycle metadata for boundary cases: lattice-review-channel is retired and non-default, product-reviewer is active INIT authority, implementation-reviewer is compatibility, and test-intent/test-case-reviewer replace or alias to canonical verification-intent without changing currently legal dispatch behavior.

For all 16 roles, compare both source template output and the two generated mirror surfaces against the pre-implementation tree; git diff must be empty for packages/main templates, .lattice-codex/agents, and .claude/agents, including newline and final-byte differences.

Exercise canonical serialization at boundary values (empty optional observations, unavailable known/provider input, multibyte text and newline-sensitive byte/line counts): repeated equivalent input must keep the same digest and measurement, while a semantically relevant contract-field change must change the canonical digest.

adversarial.desc: Mutation probes must fail closed when any required RuntimeContract, RoleContract, PromptEnvelope, or PromptMeasurementRecord field is absent, when schemaVersion is unknown, or when lifecycle status/replacement/defaultDispatch violates the frozen role policy; no partial registry or permissive fallback is accepted.

Tampering with canonical contract data, semantic/render/assembled digests, bytes, lines, estimated tokens, repetition values, or unavailable usage markers must be detected by the focused smoke/verifier rather than normalized away or reported as a passing measurement.

A controlled temporary mutation of one of the 16 assembled Prompt outputs must make the baseline verifier fail on exact bytes/hash, and restoring the source must restore PASS; accepting or refreshing the baseline hash to hide that drift is explicitly forbidden and the repository baseline/templates/mirrors must finish with an empty diff.
